evidence.note: Title claims 12 and 14 Cross-town fell 14 and 11 points and the network fell 5; these derive from the chart figures.

Chart gives Q2/Q3 2026 on-time percentages per route (86/81, 85/70, 85/74, 87/87) and a 90% target line; Note 1 cites the OVT performance dashboard Q3 2026 extract, tabs 1-2, with a link for the chart figures.
Target 90% line is covered by Note 2, which cites the OVT dashboard extract tab 1 with a link, and adds the Q2 86% figure under the same source.
'The two cross-town routes through the roadworks fell furthest; the other six routes held' is backed by Note 1 (six routes away from the roadworks, each within 2 points), cited to the dashboard.
Insight claim (routes 12 and 14 account for almost all of the fall; other six median moved under 1 point) is derived from the cited chart figures.

rationale: Every number, date and comparison on the slide traces to the chart figures, and both reader notes attach a linked source (the OVT performance dashboard Q3 2026 extract) covering the route figures, the median and the 90% target. The roadworks attribution sits in Note 1 under the same citation. No factual claim is left without a linked source.
